metric_definitions.CCG_star: mean latent competence gain over critical competencies (higher better)
metric_definitions.RWCS_star: risk-weighted latent competence at run end (higher better)
metric_definitions.TAR: share of latent competencies attaining target mastery (higher better)
metric_definitions.CMR: fixed-post-test missing required PPE count / required PPE opportunities (lower better)
metric_definitions.SOR: A-B-A scenario oscillations / eligible transitions (lower better)
metric_definitions.episodes_to_target: first episode attaining latent critical targets; episode limit when censored
metric_definitions.adaptation_latency_ms: measured implementation latency, not learning outcome

oracle_note: Oracle is privileged simulation-only and excluded from deployable claims.
